parts.text: I keep the shared picture of the airspace, which includes the network of flight corridors between sites, the zones grouping them, and the closures announced by the authorities. The authorities define zones where flying is prohibited, and they announce planned closures with start and end times, as well as sudden closures that apply right away. These closures are often amended during the day, like when an area is widened or an end time moves, and they can even come into force while drones from several companies are already in the air. When a closure is entered, I want to know how much disruption it caused across customers.
